fr_html: Le PRESIDENT fait remarquer qu'il est possible que des projets plus complets soient déposés avant lundi, et dans ce cas il appartiendrait au Comité de décider quel projet formera la base des discussions.
en_html: The PRESIDENT remarked that it was possible that some more complete projects might be submitted before Monday, and in that case it would be left to the Committee to decide which project should form the basis of discussion.
